notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ (seat) + ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧ (bedding/cushion)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Standard size is about 55×59 cm, though sizes vary
- In formal settings, guests should not sit on cushions until invited
- It's polite to fold and set aside a cushion when leaving
- Stepping on a cushion or kicking it is considered rude

POPULAR CULTURE:
On the TV show ⟦{笑点|しょうてん}→笑点：noentry⟧, performers receive {座布団|ざぶとん} as rewards for good answers—a playful use of the traditional item.
